acceptanceCriteria: A1: status reports implementation_active checkpointed finish_ready archived and closed for the corresponding lifecycle phase
A2: a valid repository-bound confirmed close decision changes status to closed without rewriting archived summary bytes
A3: missing foreign malformed unconfirmed or symlinked close decisions fail closed and never project closed
A4: repository and CLI status projections remain consistent with regression coverage for archive-before-close and close-after-archive
A5: three-language Outcome documentation explains closed as a terminal projection and preserves the human handoff boundary
goal: Make status and MCP projections reflect the terminal close decision with identity-bound fail-closed validation.
intent: Correct the request-scoped Work Item status projection so a valid close receipt is visible as closed without rewriting archive truth.
